implement.summary:
W05-04 round 2 on branch devin/pp/w05-04/impl-r2 (HEAD d8fef4b53bcf7930a078b79105dd7a454911dd8f, merge-base with BASE_SHA 7cfeacbb = BASE_SHA; r1 commits a1c1d2e3/ad99e42e/f82d6ac5 reused verbatim, then bb3008b9 regression tests, a0ba08d2 fixture correction, d8fef4b5 fix). No PR opened; nothing force-pushed.

DEFECTS FOUND (VERIFIED, against the r1 code as reused at f82d6ac5; BASE_SHA itself has none of these files, so on BASE_SHA the objective was simply unmet):
1. apps/mobile/src/screens/AnalyzeScreen.tsx:116,756 called usePublishedOfflineJourney (OfflineAllocationCard.tsx:403-412), an observe-only hook; nothing on Analyze ever read the ledger, so a spend, a HOLD, a resolved HOLD, or a HOLD persisted before relaunch was invisible until Settings happened to be opened (adversary A1/A11).
2. OfflineAllocationCard.tsx:349-361 refreshOfflineJourney read readOfflineAllocation (l.355) and readOfflineWalletStatus (l.356) in two separate transactions, and publish (l.317) fenced only on owner/generation — a slow older read could publish a torn 2-of-2 + 1-receipt snapshot over a newer correct one (A2).
3. OfflineAllocationCard.tsx:181 proLease = grants.some(entitlementSource==='verified_store') regardless of the grant's execution verdict — a lapsed Pro grant beside a live free grant produced 'Pro offline pass active' with the free grant's remaining time (A5).
4. OfflineAllocationCard.tsx:187-191,220 treated every non-queued receipt as one HOLD kind and always emitted the 'connection dropped … answer never arrived' note, including for receipts the server answered with status pending (A3); l.283 badged READY whenever the lease was active even with spendableTickets=0 (A4); wallet.hold with no pending receipt rendered '0 results awaiting confirmation' (A6).
5. OfflineAllocationCard.tsx:107-125 summarizeLease accepted any verdict.kind==='active' with no finiteness/positivity guard on remainingMs (A7).

FIX (all inside write_paths):
- OfflineAllocationCard.tsx: new exported useOfflineJourneyOnFocus(navigation) reads the ledger for the active signed-in synced owner on mount, on the screen's 'focus' event, on AppState 'active' while focused, and on every owner/session change; AnalyzeScreen.tsx now uses it (the observe-only usePublishedOfflineJourney is removed). Settings keeps useOfflineJourney (useFocusEffect). Both hooks share one applicability gate: canonical account owner AND live auth session that is non-localOnly with canonicalAppUserId === owner.ownerKey (signed-out, local-only and mismatched owners read nothing — this is what keeps the existing analyzeScreen E2E 'zero SQLite before an attempt' pins intact, since they run without an auth session, while the W05 suites run with one).
- refreshOfflineJourney: one withTransaction(getDb(), …) wrapping readOfflineAllocation + readOfflineWalletStatus (the data layer's own forDataOwner/withTransaction join the outer transaction, so no src/data edit was needed), plus a monotonic read counter; publish() now drops any read that is not the newest in addition to the owner/generation fence. Loading is published at read start so a stale READY is never shown over an in-flight read.
- Presenter: summarizeLease reports which grant governs (live Pro first, then longest live grant; active verdicts with non-finite or <=0 remainingMs become reconcile_required/invalid_lease, never live) and Pro copy follows that grant; receipts are counted per phase (queued / presented_unanswered / held) with separate notes — HOLD_RULE (unchanged wording) only for unanswered presentations, SERVER_HOLD_RULE ('still confirming') for server-held, UNIDENTIFIED_HOLD_RULE ('never recorded') with 'Unreadable' in the sync row and no count when wallet.hold has no identifiable receipt; a fully spent free pass is badge SPENT (neutral), never READY; badge and title always agree.
- Copy audited by the suite's expectDossierCompliant (no Android/Google Play/guest mode/Live Court/DUPR/competitors/percentages/superlatives).

Regression tests were written first (bb3008b9) and fail 18/34 against the pre-fix code (see AC1 note); one fixture used a non-wire status ('accepted') and was corrected to the real wire status 'result_recorded' (a0ba08d2) — that is a fixture fix, not an assertion change.

NOT DONE / SCOPE: ResultScreen.tsx (adversary A10) is not in write_paths and was not touched; the Result surface still renders no offline journey state. The r1 doc comment on the publication (OfflineAllocationCard.tsx ~l.363-369) described the removed observe-only design and was replaced together with the code it described; no other existing comments were modified.
